name: Path Morph
description: SVG paths that flow from one shape into another through a spring, with ready-made icon pairs drawn to morph cleanly.

props.name: shapes
props.description: Named shapes on a 24 grid: a path, an array of paths matched by position, or { paths, rotate }. Use a set from morphIcons or draw your own.

props.name: shape
props.description: The name of the shape to show. Changing it morphs from whatever is on screen.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke width in grid units. Caps and joins are round.

props.name: filled
props.description: Fill every path as well as stroking it. A single path can be filled with { d, fill: true }.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Without it the icon is hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: transition
props.type: { stiffness?: number; damping?: number; mass?: number }
props.description: Spring settings for every path and turn in the icon.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the svg. Other svg props are passed through.

props.name: d
props.description: Path data. A change morphs to it with a spring, starting from the shape on screen, mid-flight included. An empty string shrinks the shape to its centre.

props.name: transition
props.type: { stiffness?: number; damping?: number; mass?: number }
props.description: Spring settings.

props.name: ...props
props.description: Any other path attribute: fill, stroke, className and so on.

props.name: playing
props.description: Controlled state. Leave it out and use defaultPlaying for an uncontrolled button.

props.name: defaultPlaying
props.description: Starting state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new state when pressed.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in pixels. The glyph scales with it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button.

props.name: from
props.description: Path data at t = 0.

props.name: to
props.description: Path data at t = 1. Returns (t: number) => string. Paths with the same commands interpolate number by number; others are resampled, matched in winding and start point, so any two shapes morph.

props.name: playPause
props.description: Triangle folds into two bars.

props.name: menuClose
props.description: The outer lines bend into a cross; the middle one shrinks away.

props.name: plusMinus
props.description: The upright retracts into the bar.

props.name: plusCheck
props.description: The plus tips over into a check.

props.name: copyCheck
props.description: The front sheet folds into a check.

props.name: sunMoon
props.description: The disc opens into a crescent; the rays draw back onto its rim.

props.name: chevron
props.description: Turns the short way round.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Turns the short way round.

props.name: soundOnOff
props.description: The sound waves straighten into a cross.

props.name: eyeOpenClosed
props.description: The lids close, the pupil goes under and lashes grow.

props.name: lockUnlock
props.description: The shackle lifts free of the body.

props.name: heartFilled
props.description: A filled heart swells from the centre.

props.name: bookmark
props.description: The ribbon fills from the top.

props.name: filterClose
props.description: The funnel pinches through a star into a cross.
